program_name: Master of Science in Information Technology

fees.notes: International student tuition: RM16,800 total. Source: https://www.uniten.edu.my/programme/postgraduate/master-of-science-in-information-technology-by-research/ (UNITEN official programme page, accessed 2026-09-18). Confirmed by UNITEN International Postgraduate Fee Structure (Dec 2024). per_year = total / 2yr nominal duration.

requirements.other_qualifications: A Bachelor's degree in Computing or related fields with minimum CGPA 3.00; or CGPA 2.00-3.00 subject to rigorous internal assessment; or a non-Computing degree with minimum CGPA 2.50 subject to relevant work experience or prerequisite courses; or equivalent qualification; or APEL-A certification from MQA.
